prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: 1440×900 desktop landing-page north-star comp
Primary request: Design the first two visible folds of a premium fictional general contractor website named NORTHLINE BUILD CO. Visual direction: an architect's field notebook and measured plan sheet, tactile and human but clearly a working general contractor.
Surface structure: slender navigation aligned to a drawing title block; asymmetric first viewport with an oversized promise “BUILD IT ONCE. BUILD IT RIGHT.” at upper left, a large warm residential exterior photograph set into the plan sheet at right and slightly overlapping the grid; a clear “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE” action; hand-drawn dimension marks and two project callouts; below, the opening of a services spread laid out like three measured drawing plates. This must read unmistakably as a conversion landing page, not a poster.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI comp, desktop landscape.
Color palette: warm uncoated stock #ECE5D6, deep blueprint ink #1E2B36, brick red #A84932, muted sage #7C8878.
Materials/textures: subtle paper tooth, graphite lines, blueprint ink, one rich project photograph with natural daylight.
Typography: editorial condensed serif or narrow display face for the headline paired with practical grotesk labels; restrained handwritten annotations only for callouts.
Text (verbatim): “NORTHLINE BUILD CO.”, “BUILD IT ONCE. BUILD IT RIGHT.”, “Renovations, additions, and new homes—planned carefully and built to last.”, “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE”, “RENOVATIONS”, “ADDITIONS”, “NEW BUILDS”.
Constraints: no fabricated testimonials, star ratings, years-in-business claims, license numbers, awards, or numerical project claims; no dashboard cards; no rounded pill buttons; no gradients; no architecture-studio ambiguity—show practical build language and a prominent estimate action. Keep text crisp and legible. One dominant move only: the photograph overlapping a measured plan-sheet grid.
Avoid: mobile mockup, poster-only composition, 3D device frame, illegible invented text, excessive blueprint motifs, stock SaaS layout, bento grid, glassmorphism, watermark.
